name: claude-speedometer
description: Indicator showing the token throughput and timing of your Claude Code interactions.

commands.title: Claude Speedometer: Show / Hide Stats Tab
Claude Speedometer: Configure Claude Code Telemetry

claudeSpeedometer.port.description: Localhost port the embedded OTLP/HTTP receiver listens on. Must match the OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT configured for Claude Code.

claudeSpeedometer.exportIntervalMs.description: OTEL_LOGS_EXPORT_INTERVAL written when auto-configuring Claude Code. Lower = more responsive status bar, more frequent exports.

claudeSpeedometer.statusBarPriority.description: Status bar priority within the right-hand cluster. Higher = further left, lower = further right. The default (-Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) keeps the bolt at the far right, immediately left of the notification bell.

claudeSpeedometer.retentionDays.description: Discard interactions older than this many days from the shared history file (~/.claude-speedometer/state.json).
